meta.name: ad-to-landing-page-auditor
meta.description: Analyze the message match between your ads and landing pages. Checks if the promise in the ad copy carries through to the landing page headline, body, and CTA. Flags disconnects that kill conversion rates. Works with Google, Meta, and LinkedIn ads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查广告与落地页信息一致性，找出转化率杀手
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你投放广告后转化率不理想，想排查广告与页面是否脱节
copy.tagline_en: Check message match between ads and landing pages to find conversion killers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run ads with poor conversion and want to diagnose ad-to-page disconnect

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的广告文案和落地页是否匹配。它会检查广告的承诺是否在落地页的标题、正文和按钮上得到延续，并指出导致转化率下降的脱节之处。
howto.when: 当你询问广告点击率高但转化率低的原因，或要求审核广告到落地页的流程、检查信息匹配度时触发。

say.text: 为什么我的广告点击率高但没人转化？
帮我检查一下我们Google广告和落地页的信息匹配度。
审计我们的LinkedIn广告到落地页的流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the message match between your ad copy and landing pages. It checks if the ad's promise carries through to the landing page headline, body, and CTA, and flags disconnects that hurt conversion rates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask why ads get clicks but no conversions, or request an audit of ad-to-landing page flow or message match.

say_en.text: Why are my ads getting clicks but no conversions?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for ad copy and landing page URLs, then analyze match.

say_en.text: Check message match on our Google ads and landing pages.
say_en.note: Claude compares headlines, body, and CTAs, giving scores and fixes.

say_en.text: Audit our LinkedIn ad-to-landing page flow.
